title: Retrato de Rostro Oculto con Objetos Dispersos: Naturaleza Muerta de Botones, Monedas y Elementos Naturales
prompt: Create an image that looks like a tabletop still-life arrangement of many small objects including buttons, screws, New Zealand coins, native silver fern leaves, matchsticks, and pounamu jade fragments scattered naturally on a surface. From a top-down view, these objects are carefully arranged to form a clear human face portrait through intentional placement and shading. Use neutral tones with soft overhead light and gentle vignette. The face should emerge at mid-distance viewing: when viewed close up it appears as just scattered objects, but when zoomed out it becomes unmistakably a portrait. Add realistic cast shadows under each object to enhance depth. The background is a worn rimu wood table with natural scratches and aged patina. Keep the arrangement organic and not too symmetrical. Avoid text, obvious outlines, and artificial glow.
